deposits.genre_observed: historical political-economy paper (second half of two-part argument), numbered sections with notes and open verification list

finds.quote: The argument claims that Germany was an advanced industrial power for which labor became a binding wartime constraint, and that Lebensraum, a land program on the American and British imperial model, was turned in practice into a labor supply; that the East was conceived as a continental colony, through an institution of inner colonization older than Nazism; that conquest became labor policy, bringing millions of deported civilians and prisoners of war into Reich industry;
finds.window: 1933-1945 (Nazi war economy; camp industrial use late 1942 to mid-1944)
finds.note: The deposit's own summary of the historical theses it argues (Lebensraum turned into labor supply; inner colonization; war Fordism horizontal/vertical decomposition; campification 1942-44; labor as flow; classification as switch), with its explicit negative claims. Quote is the opening clauses of the single-line claims paragraph (contiguous substring of line 241); the rest of the sentence lists further theses and the negative claims.

finds.quote: **1.6** The objection sharpens this paper's claim. Gordon's remedy for the land problem is a transfer of labor into industry, and industry was where labor ran short. In 1934–35 rearmament brought full employment, and skilled metalworkers "became a 'scarce commodity'".[^20] By Herbert's judgment, production would have collapsed in 1942 at the latest without foreign workers.[^7] Lebensraum answered with land. What conquest delivered to the factory, from 1940 onward, was people. Labor became a binding constraint, and the empire pursued for land, settlement and racial reordering also became a mechanism for supplying it.
finds.note: Thesis that conquest delivered labor rather than land to the factory: Lebensraum as labor-supply mechanism.

finds.quote: The prisoner's death did not appear on the firm's balance sheet as destruction of an owned human capital asset; it registered as lost output, replacement and delay. When selections and mortality cut the Monowitz workforce in half, the firm applied to the SS for more prisoners.[^63] When prisoners were selected at Fürstengrube, "new prisoners replaced those who had been selected".[^64] The economic object at these sites was a flow: an allocation of persons per day, drawn from a captured population, reduced by death and refilled by transport.
finds.note: Thesis that at factory camps the economic object was a flow of allocated person-days, a third relation beside owned noun and hired verb.

finds.quote: **8.1** The grammar of the two halves. Slavery priced the noun. Fordism specified the verb. War Fordism kept the specified verb and made the noun a switch: racial-juridical classification selected the coercive regime under which the verb was extracted.
finds.note: Thesis of racial-juridical classification as a switch selecting the coercive regime; the paper's central formula.

finds.quote: [^26] The war economy gave the contiguity a physical form. The conquered population was carried into the core: Soviet civilians in residence camps segregated from Germans; eastern laborers on the line under German foremen; camp prisoners in a subcamp on the plant grounds.[^30][^45][^51] Herbert reads the forced-labor program as the preview of a continent ordered by race.[^34] The colony entered the factory. Conquest was metabolized at the industrial core.
finds.note: Thesis extending Arendt's continental imperialism to labor: the colony entered the factory. Paper says (235) Arendt did not carry her frame into labor.

finds.quote: At the level of the regime, the noun governed the verb: wage tier, ration, segregation and punishment followed classification.[^31][^30] At the level of the measured operation, the instruments of the verb found individuals, and individual capacity crossed the racial grade.[^47] The first half found the same seam in Taylor, who selected one man from a gang: individuation persisted at the point of selection.[^48] Hachtmann's own clause locates the noun: racism was "brought into the work world by the Nazis from outside".
finds.note: Thesis on aptitude testing: production system's measures crossed the racial grade, state installed classification anyway.
